representativeVariants.name: Category — neutral
representativeVariants.whySelected: Homepage tags such as #AI and #日常 use compact monochrome labels rather than colorful status chips.

representativeVariants.name: Metadata — quiet
representativeVariants.whySelected: Dates, reading times, and taxonomy labels sit in a smaller quiet treatment inside article cards.

representativeVariants.name: Inverse — footer
representativeVariants.whySelected: The dark footer reverses text and surface values while keeping the same no-radius, rule-based shape.

usageHints.priorityHint: Use for category and metadata context; do not make badges carry the primary action.
usageHints.a11y: Do not rely on color alone to communicate status; pair status with readable text.
